name: hushrun
description: Installs hushrun, which skips a check this exact code already passed, and on create fetches what the repository's backend has for it.

version.description: The release to install, such as 0.20.0, or latest.

fetch.description: On create, run hushrun fetch: the newest result of each check, and the compiled code the backend has.

pull.description: On create, run hushrun build pull: the repository's newest baked store, into /hushrun.
